item.title: Bits, Signals, and Packets
item.description:
This textbook introduces digital communications and networks through the path from information sources to physical links. It connects engineering and computer science perspectives with mathematical foundations, practical models, and exercises.

 

Key Topics

  • Information theory
  • Source coding
  • Error-correcting codes
  • Signal processing
  • Network protocols

Authors: Hari Balakrishnan, Christopher J. Terman, and George C. Verghese
